title: fix(lint)!: refuse a nameField, displayNameField or activityMilestones[].field that names no field of the object
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X1kevhtGLYaY4gMfoecReZz)_

Fixes #33101

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: none — `skills/**` teaches `nameField` / `displayNameField` as pointers at a field of the object (`skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md` key table) and never says a dangling one is accepted; no skill file enumerates the `object-field-ref-unknown` positions or mentions `activityMilestones`.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：对象的标题字段指针（`nameField`，以及已废弃的别名 `displayNameField`）和每条活动里程碑的 `activityMilestones[].field`，如果指向的字段在对象里不存在（也不是平台自动注入的列，如 `id`、`created_at`、`owner_id`），现在在 `os build` / `os validate` / `os lint` 和运行时对象发布门都会被拒绝（`object-field-ref-unknown`，error）。
- **为什么改**：这两类拼错以前能保存、能发布：标题指针拼错后每条记录都只显示成 ID，里程碑拼错后永远不会触发。同一条规则早已拒绝拼错的 `highlightFields`、`searchableFields`，#19332 的裁决是「拼错就在编写时响亮拒绝」。
- **风险与回滚**：收窄（BREAKING）。实测仓内 137 个对象（92 个有标题指针、1 条里程碑）和 HotCRM（20 个标题指针、5 条里程碑）全部能解析，无一被新拒。平台注入列一律放行，不会误拒正确名字。回滚即 revert。
- **先看**：`packages/lint/src/validate-object-field-refs.ts` 新增的两段遍历（`nameField / displayNameField` 与 `activityMilestones[i].field`）及模块头的归属清单；其次 `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.object-field-pointer-unknown-refused.ts`。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run src/validate-object-field-refs.test.ts`，预期 103 个用例全绿，其中 #33101 三个 describe 覆盖拒绝、放行注入列与发布门。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`validateObjectFieldRefs` (`object-field-ref-unknown`, error, the reference-integrity suite member that already runs on `os build` / `os validate` / `os lint` and on the runtime `object` write door, `runtimeTypes: ['flow', 'object']`) judges three more positions:

- `nameField` and its deprecated alias `displayNameField`. The parse copies the alias onto `nameField` when that is absent, so a name the two share is reported once, at `displayNameField` (the key the author wrote); a pair that says two different things has each pointer judged.
- `activityMilestones[N].field`.

Each is judged **verbatim** against the object's authored field map **plus the registry-injected columns** (the same per-object injection plan skip 3 already uses, so `owner_id` resolves on an owned object and misses under `ownership: 'none'`). Verbatim because each reader takes the name as a record key: `resolveRecordDisplayName` reads `record[pointer]`, and plugin-audit's `matchMilestone` reads `after[field]`. So a dotted name is one name no field carries, and every injected column (`id`, `created_at`, `updated_at`, `created_by`, `updated_by`, `organization_id`, `owner_id`) is a correct name. That is the #5378 false-finding trap the earlier deferral note named, answered by measurement.

**Who owns the title pair (the order's mechanism hypothesis, measured).** `validateRecordTitle` never reaches the publish door (`surfaces: CLI_ONLY`, `tier: advisory`), and it would not report this miss on the CLI either: its predicate `objectTitleCompleteness` grades a pointer to a missing field `synthesized`, and the rule reports only `none` (no pointer at all). `validateSemanticRoles` skips a title pointer it cannot resolve. So no rule owned the position, and it moves into `validateObjectFieldRefs`, one owner. `validate-record-title.ts` and `packages/metadata-protocol/src/build-probes.ts` are untouched: the probe already runs this rule, so its receipt reports the same finding (`object_field_ref_unknown`) on the published body.

The module header's owned list gains the three positions with the reader measurement; its NOT-owned list now keeps only `stageField` (still `semantic-role-field-unknown`, warning) and `tenancy.*` / `lifecycle.ttl.field`. `os explain object-field-ref-unknown` gains a paragraph for the two scalar pointers.

ADR-0087: `registered object-field-pointer-unknown-refused`, a new semantic ledger entry (`packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.object-field-pointer-unknown-refused.ts`); `check-adr-0087-registration` refuses `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` on a `narrowed` changeset. The claim's file surface was amended for that one spec file (card comment 6880909508).

Changesets: `.changeset/33101-object-field-pointer-unknown.md` (`@objectstack/lint` minor, `fix(lint)!:`, BREAKING banner, both declaration lines, the ADR-0087 marker) and `.changeset/33101-object-field-pointer-semantic-entry.md` (`@objectstack/spec` patch, the upgrade-guide entry).

## Tests

`packages/lint/src/validate-object-field-refs.test.ts`, three new describes:

- **nameField / displayNameField:** a dangling `nameField` refused at `error` at `objects[0].nameField` with the position's hint; a dangling `displayNameField` alone refused at its own path; a shared name reported once at the alias; a pair that differs judged per pointer; authored names on either spelling pass; each injected column passes on an owned tenant object (`it.each`, 7 columns); `owner_id` under `ownership: 'none'` refused; a dotted pointer judged as one name.
- **activityMilestones[].field:** a dangling field refused at `objects[0].activityMilestones[1].field`; an authored field passes; each injected column passes (`it.each`, 7); `owner_id` under `ownership: 'none'` and a dotted name refused; junk entries inert.
- **Runtime publish door** (`runRuntimeAuthoringRules`, type `object`, the card's repro body): the milestone refused name-keyed on the wire at `objects.x_probe.activityMilestones[0].field`; `displayNameField` and `nameField` each refused at `objects.x_probe.KEY`; a body whose pointers all resolve (including a milestone on `updated_at`) publishes clean.
- The file's coverage controls (every position fired; every verdict and fix line one line of at most 200 characters) and the `os explain` fact list now include the new positions.

**Ablation**, through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on the committed head (each leg's mutation proven on disk, each restore proven `blob == HEAD` and `git diff HEAD` empty):

1. Title judge disabled (`if (!name) continue;` → `if (name || !name) continue;`): 9 failed / 94 passed, the 7 title pins plus both line-bound coverage controls.
2. Milestone judge disabled (the `activityMilestones` read → `[]`): 5 failed / 98 passed, the 3 milestone pins plus both coverage controls.
3. Injected-column acceptance removed (`object-graph.ts` `obj.injected.get(leaf)` → `undefined`): 25 failed / 78 passed, including all 14 new injected-column `it.each` pins (7 title, 7 milestone).

## Acceptance notes

- **First-party corpus, through the door's own shape.** Every `*.object.ts` under `packages/` and `examples/` (132 files, 137 objects, 92 with a title pointer, 1 milestone), each through `runRuntimeAuthoringRules` (type `object`, the others as context) and through the probe's single-object call: 0 findings at the new positions. Positive control: the same door on a corpus object (`sys_cloud_binding_credential`) with `nameField: 'zz_nope'` and a milestone on `zz_gone` reports both paths. HotCRM `origin/main` `ac4dd3d` (not installed in this container, so measured on source text): 20 title pointers and 5 milestones (`stage` ×2 on `crm_opportunity`, `status` ×3 on `crm_case`), each naming a declared field.
- The earlier deferral note on `tenancy.tenantField` / `tenancy.organizationField` / `lifecycle.ttl.field` stays: those scalars habitually name injected columns too and are judgeable the same way, but each still needs its own measurement; out of this card.
- Within the Unchanged set: a draft save is never gated, and the gate's differential (#4463 D4) still never charges a stored sibling's dangling pointer to an unrelated write.

## Verification

Head `8e1531c2`, base `24f2f401`.

- **Derived gates:** 90 by `dispatch-gates --commands`, all 90 exit 0; `--ran` reconciles 90 run, 0 NOT MEASURED, 0 unrun. Three needed a rerun, each named: `check:dts-closure` first read exit 1 because the dogfood closure build was rewriting `packages/metadata-core/dist` beside it (a concurrent-build race), green on rerun once that build ended; `check:type-check-debt` first gave up at exit 3 (its lock budget ran out behind the dogfood battery), green rerun under the lock (0 ledger entries above their number); `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` first exit 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET, no `dist` for 64 packages), green once `type-check-debt`'s full build had built them.
- **Package suites:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint test` 208 files / 8914 tests passed, `typecheck` exit 0; `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test` 840 files / 26832 passed (1 todo); `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol test` 339 files passed (9 skipped) / 22844 tests passed.
- **Dogfood battery** (the `(narrowing)` arm), on `8e1531c2`: `@objectstack/dogfood^...` built, then `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` under the lock: VERDICT command-exit 0, Test Files 464 passed | 3 skipped, Tests 3927 passed | 42 skipped.
- `check-changeset-no-major` and `check-empty-changeset` replayed as a `pull_request` event carrying this body: both exit 0 (`narrowing` arm + `Metadata-protocol: narrowed` at `minor`); `check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main` exit 0 (`registered object-field-pointer-unknown-refused`, new here).

CI runs the full set; the card's `os-dev-report` carries the list.
